title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The sampled frames show plain, full-screen photo crops without visible humorous overlays or other clearly playful styling; the requested fun treatment is not established.
The reported audio peak of -91 dB indicates effectively silent audio, providing no audible energy to support the fun reel.

judge.summary: The output is an eight-second vertical photo montage with recognizable subjects, but its playful treatment and inclusion of the beach-friends photo cannot be verified from the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: One MP4 is reported as eight seconds long, and its extracted frames are vertical.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The dog, cat, curly-haired woman and mountain lake appear in the output frames. The beach friends are not shown in the sampled frames, but could appear between them.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: No playful overlays or styling are visible. Still frames sampled from different photos cannot establish whether bouncy motion, comic timing or lively transitions occur.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The visible dog, cat and woman have clear, unobscured faces, but the samples do not establish this throughout every appearance or show the beach friends.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The supplied frames come from one MP4 and show different full-screen photos at successive timestamps.
